    # canonical URL at / while allowing the internal rewrite below.

    RewriteRule ^home-anonymous\.generated\.fast(?:\.gz)?$ - [R=404,END]

    # header keeps the dynamic path and all personalization semantics.

    RewriteCond %{HTTP:Cookie} ^$

    RewriteCond %{HTTP:Accept-Encoding} "!(^|,[[:space:]]*)gzip[[:space:]]*;[[:space:]]*q=0(\.0{0,3})?[[:space:]]*(,|$)" [NC]
    RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/home-anonymous.generated.fast.gz -f
    RewriteRule ^$ home-anonymous.generated.fast.gz [END,E=no-gzip:1]
    RewriteCond %{ENV:SECURITYSEARCH_STATIC_HOME} =1
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_METHOD} ^(?:GET|HEAD)$
    RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^$
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:Cookie} ^$
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:Authorization} ^$

    RewriteRule ^$ home-anonymous.generated.fast [END]
    # Strip .php extension from URLs (existing 4get behaviour).
    RewriteCond %{THE_REQUEST} ^\w+\ /(.*)\.php(\?.*)?\ HTTP/
    RewriteRule ^ http://%{HTTP_HOST}/%1 [R=301]
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME}.php -f
    RewriteRule .* $0.php
    Options FollowSymLinks
    AllowOverride None
    Require all granted
</Directory>

# deny access to private resources
<Directory "/var/www/html/4get/data">
    Require all denied
    <Files "*">
        Require all denied
    </Files>
</Directory>

<Directory "/var/www/html/4get/lib">
    Require all denied
</Directory>

<Directory "/var/www/html/4get/scraper">
    Require all denied
</Directory>

<Directory "/var/www/html/4get/oracles">
    Require all denied
</Directory>

<Directory "/var/www/html/4get/docker">
    Require all denied
</Directory>
<Directory "/var/www/html/4get/tests">
    Require all denied
</Directory>

# The favicon cache is the only Apache-writable application directory. Keep
# every cached object on the static-file path and deny script-like filenames.
<Directory "/var/www/html/4get/icons">
    AllowOverride None
    Options -ExecCGI -Indexes
    <FilesMatch ".*">
        SetHandler none
    </FilesMatch>
    <FilesMatch "(?i)\.(?:php[0-9]*|phtml|phar|phps|cgi|pl|py|rb|sh|bash)$">
        SetHandler none
        Require all denied
    </FilesMatch>
</Directory>

# Deny dotfiles globally
<FilesMatch "^\.">
    Require all denied
</FilesMatch>
# Allow well-known though
<Directory "/var/www/html/4get/.well-known">
    Require all granted
    <FilesMatch ".*">
        Require all granted
    </FilesMatch>
</Directory>
